fixed.problem: BA-3: a task's review was capped only by the session's token, so a review could take the task past its budget. A run-level refusal read as the session's budget, and the refused call's estimate never reached the card.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/task-budget-all.test.ts 'BA-3: a review its task's budget cannot pay a first call for is not started ...' and 'BA-3: a review is capped at what is left of its task's budget ...'; packages/runtime/test/loop.test.ts and packages/critic/test/refused-review.test.ts 'd1116-budget-all, run C'; packages/critic/test/review-price.test.ts (new)
fixed.how: The runner passes the task's budget less its figure as TaskReviewRequest.budgetUsdMicro, and the critic token takes the smaller amount. reviewStopSource maps a run-level refusal to task_budget. A review whose remaining budget is below one critic call's floor (CriticPort.reviewCallUsdMicro().floorUsdMicro) does not start: the task pauses cleanly with its work kept, and Continue runs only the review, after a restart too. RunResult.error and ReviewRefusal now carry estimateUsdMicro.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Give a footer task Budget 0.07 and start a session. The Inbox shows '... paused at its budget of CHF 0.07' with 'The work is done; its review waits for room in the budget.' Press Continue: the next session's log shows only the critic reviewing it ('its work was done in an earlier session'), and the task becomes Done.

fixed.problem: BA-4: a work run, including a fix after a send-back, could spend the whole task budget, so its review always had to wait for Continue.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/task-budget-all.test.ts 'BA-4: a fix after a send-back keeps room ...'; packages/runtime/test/task-budget-room.test.ts (runCapOf/workRunCapOf/budgetLineWords/pauseSentence/card body)
fixed.how: workRunCapOf keeps R + W out of the work cap when that is at most half of what is left. R is the review part (PlanItem.reviewRoomUsdMicro, set by the runner through planner.reviewPartOf); W is one critic call's worst case (CriticPort.reviewCallUsdMicro). runCapSource follows the work cap. The start line, the pause sentence and the card name the room only when one is kept: 'This run may spend CHF 0.20 (CHF 0.04 of the task's budget is kept for its review): ...', '; CHF 0.04 is kept for its review', 'It spent CHF 0.56 of its budget of CHF 0.80, keeping CHF 0.10 for its review.'. A sent-back task whose budget is spent gets the decided sentence.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Give a task Budget 2.00 and start a session. Session page > Details: each run of it says 'This run may spend CHF 1.89 (CHF 0.10 of the task's budget is kept for its review): ...'.

fixed.problem: BA-5: Continue on a waiting review added only 'the same amount again', which could be too little for a review of two calls, so a second card came.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/task-budget-all.test.ts 'BA-5, BA-3: a review that waits at its task's budget gets what it needs from one Continue ...' (restart, two-call reading review); packages/runtime/test/continuity-budget.test.ts (changed for the design)
fixed.how: A task_budget card stores needs_usd_micro. For a work pause this is the estimate left plus W, beyond what is left. For a waiting review it is R plus the refused call's worst case, beyond what is left. continueUsdMicro gives the larger of this and the same amount again. The button still names exactly what it adds.
fixed.check_in_the_app: On the footer card above, press Continue once: no second card comes and the task is Done.

new_problems: The bench-api stand-in critic sent the Swiss task back 4 times although the daemon was restarted with --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_REJECT_TIMES=1 (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1116-budget-all/steps/after2-budget-all.json: 'Needs your decision: tried 4 times'). Either restart-daemon.mjs --env does not reach the role player, or REJECT_TIMES is not read on the bench-api path. This affects bench walks only, not the product.

The paused card's Continue explanation reads 'starts a session that goes on from where it stopped' even when the work is done and only the review waits (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1116-budget-all/steps/12-after2-06-inbox.png). A wording polish for d1109-oversize-pause's card words, which this area must not touch apart from the room clause.

Bench-only caveat (spec): FORERUNNER_BENCH_USAGE and FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_USAGE add input tokens after the precheck, so a run they inflate can pass its work cap. The real-daemon W15-14 world showed the same with its injected 145k-token usage: 'stopped at its budget of CHF 0.15, less the CHF 0.04 kept for its review, after spending CHF 0.12' (the work cap was CHF 0.11). The task's own budget was not passed. The evidence that no budget is passed comes from the composed tests (task-budget-all.test.ts).
notes_for_other_areas: RunResult.error.estimateUsdMicro (agent/loop.ts) and ReviewRefusal.estimateUsdMicro: the refused call's estimate, stored on the card.

CriticPort.reviewCallUsdMicro(task, specialist?) -> {worstUsdMicro, floorUsdMicro, maxEffort} (loop/ports.ts), built on CriticService.reviewCallUsdMicro(tier, projectSettings) and REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ALLOWANCE_TOKENS = 8,000 (critic.ts).
TaskReviewRequest.onCost and .budgetUsdMicro (append-only): every critic call is booked on the task; the review is capped at the task's budget less its figure.

PlanItem.reviewRoomUsdMicro and Planner.reviewPartOf?(task) (runner.ts); workRunCapOf(task, specialistLimit, reviewRoom) -> {capUsdMicro, roomUsdMicro, source} (executor.ts); BudgetStop.roomUsdMicro; PausedWork.estimateLeftUncappedUsdMicro.

Budget card change_card fields: needs_usd_micro (what one Continue must add at the task's budget) and room_usd_micro (what the run kept for its review); continueUsdMicro(task, stop, rate, {needsUsdMicro}).

EstimateResult.reviewUsdMicro / reviewRatio; exported reviewPartUsdMicro(task, floor?, starts?) and REVIEW_STARTING_ESTIMATES_USD_MICRO {1: 30_000, 2: 90_000, 3: 300_000} (estimates/model.ts): the one place for the owner to tune the review part. EstimateModelOptions.reviewFloor; estimate snapshot version 3; samples kept by task id; onTaskFinished fires at the task's close; the daemon calls refreshEstimates() before GET /projects/:id/start-check and before pricing a plan card.

PLAN_COUNTS_ALL = 'all' on plans the runner writes (plan.counts); critic planCountsAll(plan); SessionMetrics.counts / tasksUsdMicro / otherUsdMicro; SessionReviewData.countsAll / plannedTasksUsdMicro.
costLedger.byTaskOf(projectId, {from, to}) (state, append-only): each task now in the project with every ledger row booked to it; used by TaskView.spent and Costs > By task.
Migration 0010 'task-spent-all' (data only). The next migration number is 0011.

Suggested CHANGELOG / UPDATE-LOG line (the session lead's files, not edited): 'A task's budget now counts its whole cost: its work, the critic's reviews and any fixes (the owner's answer of 2026-11-16). Each run keeps room for its review, one Continue is enough when a review waits, estimates include the review, and the Tasks row, drawer and Costs show one figure ("of CHF 0.20 budget").'

Live check 4 (LC-C32) input: on the real critic, measure the first review call's real worst case and cost against reviewCallUsdMicro (Sonnet 5.5 worst case about USD 0.10 by the decision), and which branch a Budget 0.10 footer task takes. On the stand-in it took the done branch (no room kept, review fit); at Budget 0.07 the review waited and one Continue finished it.
